name: Gaigel
summary: Swabian trick-taking card game with double 24-card deck, trump, melding and race to 101 points.
rules_text: Gaigel uses 48 cards (two each of A,10,K,Q,J,7 in four suits). One suit is trump. Each player is dealt 5 cards, rest forms talon with trump card exposed underneath. Forehand chooses an opening mode for the first trick (e.g. face-down ace, face-up ace, or face-down non-trump non-ace where higher same suit wins). Afterwards winner leads; while talon remains, there is no must-follow or must-trump. Winner draws from talon first. After winning a trick a player may meld King+Queen of same suit for 20 points (40 if trump), showing the pair and later playing one card from it. A trump 7 held can be swapped for the exposed trump card if holder has a trick. When talon empties, must follow suit and win if possible. First side to 101 card points including melds calls out to win. Five 7s instantly wins, four 7s can announce Auf Siebener and try to draw fifth.
rating_reason: Specific trick game variant with double deck, team option
